entities.name: Dục Đức
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dục Đức, was emperor of Vietnam for three days, from 20 to 23 July 1883. He was the fifth emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty and father of Emperor Thành Thái, who ruled from 1889 to 1907.
